title: Chapter 648
paragraphs: Chapter 648
Episode 165. After the Shock (2)
After Rosa was swallowed by chaos, approximately a thousand knights had raised their banner in her Runcandel.
They had waged both large and small battles against the Garden of Swords, led by Diphus, Mary, and Jordan.
However, over 60% of them were suppressed even before a month had passed, and the remaining ones had to make a choice.
Would they plan for the future, or would they fight to the death?
The choice was the former.
But they couldn't carry it out. Rosa found the hideouts of the rebels too easily and lured them into the Garden of Swords like a game of chase.
The rebels put up a fight against the family knights tainted by chaos, but in the end, all were defeated by the summoned past knights and the black knights.
At that time, about 250 knights were locked in the underground prison.
And the knights that Quicantel brought now were less than a hundred. In the process of escaping the Garden of Swords this time, over half of the remaining knights lost their lives.
A total of 97 people.
Jin stared at them silently for a while. His chest felt heavy as if it was about to burst.
"You all... have suffered a lot."
As Jin finally spoke, the knights saluted with their swords.
No one shed tears. Jin also swallowed his boiling emotions and received the knights' salute.
'If there's any relief, none of the survivors are infected with chaos to the point where they cannot be treated with a purifier.'
The chaos that had tainted the knights wasn't too deep. However, many of them had serious physical injuries, so the aid of the Holy Kingdom's healers would be needed.
"First of all, it would be best for everyone to start with treatment. We have a device that can purify the chaos."

Jin explained to the knights about the purifier. It was a long treatment period and the target was limited, and since the blood of the gods was used as a medium, it was useless to the Garden of Swords tainted by chaos.
"I've had it, 12th knight."
Jordan spoke.
"Elder?"
"What are you saying? You should be the first to be treated, Elder...."
The Tona brothers started to respond to Jordan but stopped. They belatedly realized what he meant.
Jordan didn't appear to have a fatal wound, but he was in a state of irreversible internal injury. The price for the survival of the 97 knights was his life.
Jin had known about Jordan's condition from the first moment he saw him.
"Why are you all making such stupid faces? Just like the 12th knight said, receive treatment and purification. I have one last job to do before I die."
Jordan met Jin's gaze.
"12th Knight."
"Yes."
"From now on, I will pass on all the family swords I know. It would be best to head to the training grounds immediately. I don't have much time left."
Jin decided to follow Jordan's words. Even if Lani herself came, resurrection was impossible, and he deserved respect.
"Understood."
"Don't worry too much, the handover won't take long. On the way, I'll explain things you might be curious about. Also, tell me about your experiences in the Garden of Swords."
On the way to the training grounds, Jordan often had to stop walking.
Jin explained the past battles, understanding how great Jordan's will was to fulfill his last mission.
"So in the end, you crossed swords with Rosa herself... Yet you were not affected by chaos at all."
"I became immune."
"It's probably not the kind of immunity you can distribute to everyone. I'm envious. Looking back, it seems that everyone in the family felt that way about you."
Jin didn't answer and waited for his next words.
"The Garden of Swords has been like this for half a year."
"I had some expectations since they blocked Calron and controlled information about me from that time."

"Until then, Rosa Runcandel had been having seizures. Eventually, she broke her promise with you and joined hands with the prophet. It was a decisive moment. Zipple and Kinzlo were building a fleet and using all kinds of new technologies, and we were falling behind. Of course, it wasn't right."
It was just that there were no other options.
Jordan added in a bitter voice.

"Rosa would have made the same choice even if you hadn't left. Therefore, your decision to go into seclusion was rather correct. If you had stayed in the family, the first thing Rosa would have done was to eliminate you. Since there was no family head... no one could have stopped it."
"Is there still no news about my father?"
Even now, when the era has drastically changed.
The authority of Chiron Runcandel, a knight, has not lost its value at all.
If he and the knights who went on an expedition with him were there, Runcandel would have been a land that other powers couldn't easily cross, even without a prophet or a fleet.
"...Rosa said the family head is dead."
Jin stopped in his tracks for a moment.
"Was there any basis for that?"

"No. I don't know if she found out through the prophet's ability, or she just said it to establish her own legitimacy. She just said he was dead. But I also don't expect the family head to be alive. Almost all of those who had raised their banner against Rosa thought so."
Whether Chiron survived or died.
It was difficult to carry much significance.

As the family head who did not return from an external mission as the family reached this point, he was already unqualified from an objective point of view. It was almost no different from being dead already.
"However, a few thought differently. Your uncles and brothers did. Zed Runcandel, he left for the Black Sea to find the family head as soon as Rosa's tyranny began."
Zed had not yet returned, and therefore his life and death were also unclear.

"The 4th and 7th knights are missing since the last battle. As I said, we don't know if they're alive or dead. But if they escaped alive, they probably headed to the Black Sea as well. These two also used to say that the only way to resolve the situation is to find the family head."

"So, no one actually witnessed the deaths of Brother Diphus and Sister Mary. Perhaps, they may still be trapped in the Garden of Swords. I don't think Rosa would have freed everyone trapped in the underground dungeon."

"That's possible. But if so, they are likely to appear as your enemies. One of the reasons why we, the 1,033 knights, could resist Rosa was our will, but a significant reason was that we weren't exposed to the chaos that the prophet directly released."
"Do you mean that most of the knights remaining in the Garden of Swords raised their flags not of their own will, but were eroded by chaos?"

"There may be some who did it willingly. But as you said, most of them probably didn't. Which crazy knight would want to fight under such a monster? No matter how strong that monster is. The knights that make up Runcandel, especially, have a high sense of pride."
It was already known from many examples that it was nearly impossible for a human to resist the madness of chaos.
It was possible only for a special person like Ron. Even Ron was completely consumed until he received Jin's help.
'Brother Diphus and Sister Mary may appear as enemies...'
The thought of it made his head feel like it was going to explode.
Jin kept his composure and continued to match his steps with Jordan.
"It seems we've arrived. It's quite a decent training ground, did you mostly hone and polish your sword here during your time as a knight candidate?"
"Yes."
"Jin."
"Yes."
"Now you're the family's only hope. Never... forget that."
Saying so, Jordan was tightly holding Jin's hand.
The only knight who could fight without restrictions against the huge chaos known as Rosa Runcandel, the only knight who could right the family.
Jordan was crying.

The current state of Runcandel plummeted into the abyss, regret for the days when he struggled to become the family head, the fallen comrades, the helplessness of having no choice but to entrust everything to the 12th knight.
Such emotions were wildly mixed, making Jordan cry.
"......Understood, Uncle."
For the next three days.
Jordan handed down to Jin six decisive battles, four secrets, and one technique.

Jin, who had already reached a high level of skill, quickly grasped the subtleties of these techniques, most of them perfectly implemented without needing to see Jordan demonstrate them, but understanding just from explanations.
From time to time, when Jordan needed a rest due to exhaustion, Jin would go up to the mansion to receive various reports about the current situation.
As expected, the leaders of each force were hastily requesting a conference in Tikan.
Runcandel showed no special movement until then. There was no troop movement, but there were reports that the rate at which Huphester was being eroded had slowed down a bit.
There was still no news from Valeria. He wanted to confirm her life or death immediately by any means, but he could not leave Tikan until the meeting with the major powers ended.
That was the order. Of those who bear the family and the world.
"Now all the teachings are over."
Jordan said in a hoarse voice.
While teaching the sword, they had been conversing not as an elder and knight, or as enemies and non-enemies, but in an atmosphere like a good uncle and nephew.
"Do you remember the day I broke your two arms?"
"How can I forget, Uncle."
"Actually, that day, I saw your father, the family head, in you. The sight of you approaching me stride by stride with your arms severed haunted me in my nightmares for a while."
"I was quite scared that day too."
"Heh, now you're comforting me as I die."
"The truth is, I was really worried about what if the arms didn't attach back perfectly. And I, in fact, was certain then that your end would not be good, Uncle."
"You must have planned it that way."
"Because at that time, you and I were no different from enemies."
"After that day, I thought you could be a guy more dangerous than Joshua and even Rosa."
Squeak, shiii...
There was a metallic sound in Jordan's breath.
The moment of his death was approaching.
"Do you still hold the same thought?"
"Yes...... You are the one to defeat Rosa, to become the family head. But..."
Whoosh!
Suddenly, Jordan mustered his last strength and caught Jin's shoulder as if hooking it.

"Never ever, think that you have already become the family head. Even if all the remaining resistors accept you as their lord. Whether your father is dead or alive. You only qualify once you reclaim the Garden of Swords. You must reclaim the Garden of Swords... understand...."
Jin gritted his teeth and nodded, and Jordan breathed his last.
And a day after he passed away.
A knight from Runcandel entered Tikan.
